crossRefs.note: An evil spirit from Yahweh was on Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing with…
Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he stuck the spear…
Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.
Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in…
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through…
They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.
translations.bsb: and he hurled it, thinking, “I will pin David to the wall.” But David eluded him twice.
translations.kjv: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
translations.asv: and Saul cast the spear; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
